name: Site Descriptor
description: Minimal repository-side identity for the Site consuming NEXT F contracts.
purpose: Lets Codex, validation tooling and runtime adapters identify the Site without duplicating the full core.site record.

fields.description: Human-readable development label for the Site.
Descriptive Site type. Site type never grants functionality.

options.label: Service Business
options.description: Service-led website focused on offerings, proof and enquiries.

options.label: Lead Generation
options.description: Conversion-led website where qualified enquiries are a primary business outcome.

options.label: Commerce
options.description: Website with the NEXT F Commerce module and transactional storefront capabilities.

options.label: Custom
options.description: Site whose primary purpose does not fit another descriptive type. Modules still define capabilities.

relationships.description: siteId must resolve to the canonical Site record in trusted platform context.

validationRules.description: siteId must resolve to exactly one canonical core.site when connected to NEXT F Platform.
siteType is descriptive only. Enabled Modules and Capabilities determine functional behavior.
primaryUrl is a technical reference and never implies NEXT F owns the domain or hosting service.

delivery.notes: Manifest definitions contain technical declarations only. Secret values are prohibited.
